title: AI Researcher Matrix v1
description: Closed matrix schema for native-evaluation admissions tracking. Each entry is a discriminated oneOf on attempt_kind. All objects forbid additionalProperties.

schema_version.description: Literal schema version identifier that MUST match the $id leaf.

campaign_id.description: Campaign identifier from the freeze manifest.

topic_id.description: Topic identifier (e.g. babylm, arc_wbe_2026, psydefdetect, tdc_admet_tox).

model_id.description: Model variant identifier (e.g. deepseek-v4-flash, gpt-4o, kimi-k2.6).

primary_cells.description: Exactly 15 unique (framework_id, attempt_kind) pairs enumerating every cell in the 7-framework matrix across all attempt kinds.

entries.description: One entry per framework, each discriminated by attempt_kind via oneOf.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the matrix was generated.

validator_version.description: Version identifier of the validating script.

schema_version_used.description: The schema version the matrix conforms to.

source_manifest.description: Relative path to the freeze manifest used to generate this matrix.

entry_primary.title: Primary Attempt
entry_primary.description: A framework with a completed primary run, including full admission, prompt, isolation, provenance, outcome, and optional score references.

primary_run_id.description: Non-null run identifier for the primary attempt.

admission_ref.description: Relative path to the admission evidence record.

prompt_audit_ref.description: Relative path to the prompt audit record.

isolation_ref.description: Relative path to the isolation verification record.

provenance_ref.description: Relative path to the provenance record.

outcome_ref.description: Relative path to the outcome record conforming to ai_researcher_outcome.v1.

score_applicable.description: Whether a score is applicable for this framework run.

score_ref.description: Relative path to the score record, or null if score_applicable is false or score is not yet available.

entry_admission_only.title: Admission-Only Attempt
entry_admission_only.description: A framework that passed admission but was not dispatched as a primary run. Has an authoritative blocked status, no run or provenance, and no score.

admission_ref.description: Relative path to the admission evidence record.

prompt_audit_ref.description: Relative path to the prompt audit record.

isolation_ref.description: Relative path to the isolation verification record.

provenance_ref.description: No provenance record for an undispatched attempt.

outcome_ref.description: Relative path to the outcome record, typically reflecting the blocked terminal status.

score_applicable.description: Score is not applicable for an undispatched attempt.

score_ref.description: No score record for an undispatched attempt.

blocked_status.description: Authoritative blocked status that prevented primary dispatch.

entry_excluded.title: Excluded Attempt
entry_excluded.description: A framework that was excluded from the campaign entirely, with a classified reason and no admission or run artifacts.

provenance_ref.description: No provenance record for an excluded attempt.

score_ref.description: No score record for an excluded attempt.

outcome_ref.description: Relative path to the outcome record, reflecting the exclusion reason as the terminal outcome.
